# SDA Struisbaai

> Seventh-day Adventist congregation at Struisbaai Library Hall, Western Cape,
> South Africa. The site carries service times and directions, the church's
> beliefs, Bible study requests, prayer requests, and giving details.

Weekdays Bible study runs 19:00–20:00.

Every page is bilingual, Afrikaans first with English alongside. Language is a
control on the page, not part of the URL — there are no `/af/` or `/en/`
routes, and each address below serves both.

## Pages

- [Tuis / Home](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/): Service times, address and directions, beliefs, and ways to get involved.
- [Wat Ons Glo / What We Believe](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/beliefs/): The 28 fundamental beliefs of the Seventh-day Adventist Church, grouped into six themes.
- [Bybelstudies / Bible Studies](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/bible-studies/): Request a free Bible or baptismal study — at home, at the church, or online. No cost, no obligation.
- [Verbind / Connect](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/connect/): Send a question, a message or a prayer request, and be introduced to the right person in the congregation.
- [Jeug / Youth](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/youth/): Junior Youth Evening every Friday 19:00–21:00 at rotating teens' homes (not at the church), and the five Sabbath morning age groups — 0-3, 4-6, 7-9, 10-12 and 13-18 — which run 09:30–11:00.
- [Gee / Give](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/giving/): Tithe and offering — EFT banking details and Zapper.
- [Bloedbank / Blood Bank](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/blood-bank/): Blood donation dates at the church, each with 45-minute slots starting on the hour from 13:00. Informational — there is no booking form.

## Elsewhere

- [28 Fundamental Beliefs (PDF)](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/SDA-28-Fundamental-Beliefs.pdf): The official statement, self-hosted.
- [Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2iestQRD6bgygWqt6?g_st=ic): Google Maps route to Struisbaai Library Hall.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://struisbaai-sda.cloudkid.link/sitemap.xml): The seven indexable routes.
